author: Mark Atwood
text: Sibling-propagation note for q2wa.16: MemoryError in crate-jmap-mail-server was reshaped from pub tuple struct (pub String) to #[non_exhaustive] named-field struct with ::new constructor and ::description accessor. Every sibling extension-server crate (chat-server, calendars-server, contacts-server, tasks-server, filenode-server, metadata-server, sharing-server) has its own MemoryError type with the same antipattern — sweep needed.
